name: Cloud
style: low-poly, flat colours, rounded multi-lobed cumulus (Quaternius 2021)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static cloud on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge, and the Ultimate Nature Pack used for the trees has no cloud. This is Cloud_2 from Quaternius's Ultimate Platformer Pack on itch.io (free download; License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0). Of the pack's three clouds (all rendered) it reads best as a puffy cumulus: a big central lobe with a smaller puff on each side over a flat base, the classic anime cloud profile, where Cloud_1 is two lumps and Cloud_3 a long sloping mound. The broad side faces +Z (the front view shows the three lobes); y = 0 is the flat bottom. Size: a sky prop, 15 m tall, about 25 m wide and 15 m deep; real cumulus are hundreds of metres across, so a film places it far off or scales it (uniform scale keeps the base flat). Colours on indigo: sclera white shading to moon pale blue, with ink. noInk was tried too: without the hull the lobes merge into one white blob and the cloud reads as a lump, so the ink stays (it also draws the creases between puffs). Shade threshold 0 (default 0.35): at the default half the cloud went blue in patches; at 0 the shade sits on the underside and the far side, the flat-bottomed anime cumulus look. Smooth shading kept so the shade falls as soft bands. Static: no clips.
